title: Tied Goods and Consumer Switching Costs
eligible_reason: Dynamic structural demand model of camera-body and lens purchases with switching costs created by proprietary lens mounts, estimated by ML on a consumer-month panel (120 months); counterfactuals on compatibility. No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: runcode.m -> LoadData.m (main_data.txt: id, year, month, brand_type, lens counts, purchase indicators, price factors f1-f6), precode.m, estimate.m with likelihood.m / likelihood_mix.m and FixedPointU.m. README: package starts from a cleaned dataset and ends with the demand-side parameter estimates. Regression inventory empty (MATLAB only).
data_files_note: Cleaned estimation panel shipped (579,840 consumer-month rows); no statement that it is simulated or disguised.
data_provenance_note: Cleaned estimation data as described in the README; moot because the design is not a DiD.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
